Compiled (64-bit) using Clang 14.0.3 (clang-1403.0.22.14.1), with GLib 2.80.3,
with libpcap, without POSIX capabilities, with zlib 1.2.11, with zlib-ng 2.1.6,
with PCRE2, with Lua 5.4.6, with GnuTLS 3.8.4 and PKCS #11 support, with Gcrypt
1.10.2, with Kerberos (MIT), with MaxMind, with nghttp2 1.62.1, with nghttp3
1.1.0, with brotli, with LZ4, with Zstandard, with Snappy, with libxml2 2.11.9,
with libsmi 0.4.8, with binary plugins.

Running on macOS 14.1.2, build 23B92 (Darwin 23.1.0), with Apple M1 Max, with
65536 MB of physical memory, with GLib 2.80.3, with libpcap 1.10.1, with zlib
1.2.12, with PCRE2 10.39 2021-10-29, with c-ares 1.31.0, with GnuTLS 3.8.4, with
Gcrypt 1.10.2, with nghttp2 1.62.1, with nghttp3 1.1.0, with brotli 1.0.9, with
LZ4 1.10.0, with Zstandard 1.5.6, with libsmi 0.4.8, with LC_TYPE=C, binary
plugins supported.
